message:
You know that one friend who panics at the first sign of a storm? I think we all have one! 🌪️ I used to be that friend, but I've learned that a bit of prep can turn those stormy days into cozy moments at home instead of frantic scrambling. The Red Cross has some really helpful tips for hurricane preparedness that I found quite useful. It’s all about being ready without turning into a weather warrior! 

What’s your best tip for staying calm and ready during storms?
